title: -cion --- About Two Thousand Words, At Once
label: ch:friend-cion
canDo: I can turn an English -tion word into Spanish and know its gender without being told.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C56-cion: convert an English -tion word, give the gender, and say why the correspondence is a rule.
payoff.note: The highest-reach lesson in the book so far: one ending, roughly two thousand words, and a gender that never has to be decided. Not a resemblance -- Latin -tionem, inherited by Spanish and borrowed by English.
